stages.name: first phase
stages.note: Single round-robin: each club meets every other club once.

stages.name: championship group
stages.note: 1st-6th after the first phase; the winner is champion and takes a Champions League place.

conflicts.topic: The league article still describes the old 18-club season
conflicts.detail: The competition-format prose says '18 clubs ... 34 games ... three lowest-placed teams are relegated' and cites a format 'since 2015'. The 2026-27 season is the first with 20 clubs and a two-phase split (19 rounds, then 6 + 14), with four relegated; the infobox and the 2026-27 team list already show 20.
The league expanded from 18 to 20 for 2026-27 (three promoted from the Second Division A, one extra place from the reshuffle). Our row says 20, which is right for this season and wrong for 2025-26.
Unlike the old double round-robin, the 2026-27 first phase is one match per opponent (19 games), then the table splits. A sim that keeps a 38-round table will overplay the season by half.

The 2026-27 article says the league 'splits into two groups' but does not say whether first-phase points are carried. `points_carry` is left null rather than guessed; the usual Egyptian split practice is to carry them, but this is a new format with no completed season to check.

conflicts.topic: Four relegated from a single row
conflicts.detail: Because EGY1 is the only Egyptian league in our list, the direction is closed in the report even though four clubs actually go down to the Second Division A.

notes: Season 2026-27 (started 21 August 2026, in progress). Size 20 matches our row but is one season old in our data (18 in 2024-25 and 2025-26). Format: 19-round single round-robin, then a six-club championship group and a fourteen-club relegation group, four relegated. Round counts for the two groups and whether points carry are not stated in the source. Cups and CAF competitions excluded.
